notes.title: Fixes
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*]The brightness of the game is increased
[*]The duration of the free weather has been increased
[*]Fixed bug with incorrectly displayed minimap.
[*]Fixed bug with not rotating wheels on the muscle car.
[/olist]

notes.title: Climbing Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=hvRLIZLFBvk;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] The new climbing system will allow you to climb previously inaccessible areas of the map.
[*] Added new secret places to get to which you can use climbing.
[/list]

notes.title: New modular construction system
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=zrfGX8hHJw8;full][/previewyoutube]

- The new recipe "Construction Plan"
- The new modular construction system, allows you to create a completely unique house.
- The player now appears not empty-handed, but with a basic set of items that will facilitate the start of the game.

notes.title: Fixes
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Doubled the survival time of a character without food and water, now it is 10 minutes for hunger and 13 minutes for water.
[*] Increased the overall brightness of day and night
[*] In the menu on the button "I" added the ability to manually change the time of day and weather.
[*] Removed from the options settings that are not currently implemented. Only the settings for graphics are working.
[/olist]
